meta.title: Indian Elections 2024–2029
meta.note: All 2024 Lok Sabha and 2025 state election data is official. 2026 state elections recently concluded. Next major elections: UP, Punjab, Goa (Feb 2027), then Lok Sabha 2029.

phases.description: ECI announces 7-phase schedule for the 18th General Elections.
phases.details: Chief Election Commissioner announced the 7-phase schedule. MCC came into effect. 543 Lok Sabha constituencies across 7 phases from April 19 to June 1, 2024.

phases.description: 102 constituencies in 21 states/UTs.
phases.details: 102 constituencies voted. Arunachal Pradesh & Sikkim simultaneously held assembly elections (BJP retained both).

phases.description: 89 constituencies in 13 states/UTs.
phases.details: 89 constituencies. Major battles in Kerala (20 seats) and Karnataka. Higher turnout than Phase 1.

phases.description: 94 constituencies in 12 states/UTs.
phases.details: All 26 Gujarat seats voted. Andhra Pradesh and Odisha simultaneously held assembly elections.

phases.description: 96 constituencies — Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha.
phases.details: Highest turnout phase. All 25 AP seats in one phase. TDP-led NDA swept Andhra Pradesh simultaneously winning the state assembly.

phases.description: 49 constituencies — Rajasthan, Maharashtra, West Bengal.
phases.details: Rajasthan completed all voting. J&K Anantnag-Rajouri postponed due to security. Relatively lower turnout phase.

phases.description: 58 constituencies — Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh.
phases.details: All 7 Delhi seats and all 10 Haryana seats. UP's major seats including Lucknow (Rajnath Singh) voted.

phases.description: 57 constituencies — Varanasi (PM Modi), Punjab, Himachal.
phases.details: Final phase. PM Modi's Varanasi constituency voted. All 13 Punjab seats and 4 Himachal Pradesh seats in this phase.

phases.description: NDA wins 293 seats. PM Modi forms third term coalition government.
phases.details: NDA: 293 seats (BJP 240, TDP 16, JDU 12, others). INDIA: 234 seats (INC 99, SP 37, TMC 29, others). Others: 16. BJP fell short of 272 majority for first time since 2014. Coalition government with TDP and JDU as kingmakers. National turnout: 65.79%.

phases.description: Narendra Modi sworn in as PM for third consecutive term. NDA coalition cabinet formed.
phases.details: 72-member NDA Cabinet sworn in at Rashtrapati Bhavan. TDP's Chandrababu Naidu and JDU's Nitish Kumar played key roles in government formation. Coalition government dependent on allies for majority.

phases.description: BJP wins third consecutive term in Haryana defeating INC.
phases.details: BJP won 48 seats vs INC's 37. Nayab Singh Saini sworn in as CM. Unexpected BJP win against exit poll predictions of INC majority. Source: ECI State Results Oct 2024.

phases.description: NC-Congress alliance wins. First assembly election after Article 370 abrogation.
phases.details: National Conference (42) + Congress (6) = 48 seats, won majority. Omar Abdullah sworn in as CM of J&K UT. BJP won 29 seats. First assembly election post-370 abrogation. Source: ECI 2024.

phases.description: Mahayuti (BJP-Shiv Sena-NCP) wins landslide. Devendra Fadnavis returns as CM.
phases.details: Mahayuti won 230 seats (BJP 132, Shiv Sena Shinde 57, NCP Ajit 41). MVA won 50 seats. Devendra Fadnavis sworn in as CM. Biggest alliance sweep in Maharashtra history. Source: ECI Nov 2024.

phases.description: JMM-led INDIA alliance wins. Hemant Soren retains power.
phases.details: JMM won 34, Congress 16, RJD 4 (INDIA total: 56 seats). BJP won 21. Hemant Soren sworn in for second term. Tribal electorate decisive. Source: ECI Nov 2024.

phases.description: BJP wins Delhi after 10 years, ending AAP's rule.
phases.details: BJP won 48 seats vs AAP's 22. INC won 0 seats. Arvind Kejriwal lost his own seat (New Delhi). Rekha Gupta sworn in as Delhi CM. First BJP government in Delhi since 2013. Source: ECI Feb 2025.

phases.description: NDA (BJP-JDU) alliance retains power. Nitish Kumar continues as CM.
phases.details: NDA won 133 seats (BJP 77, JDU 51, others 5). INDIA bloc won 101 seats (RJD 79, Congress 15, others 7). Nitish Kumar sworn in for ninth term as Bihar CM. Source: ECI Oct 2025.

phases.description: DMK sweeps. MK Stalin re-elected for second term as CM.
phases.details: DMK-led INDIA alliance won 178 seats (DMK 151, Congress 18, others 9). AIADMK won 47. BJP won 4. MK Stalin sworn in as CM for second term. High turnout driven by welfare scheme voting. Source: ECI Apr 2026.

phases.description: TMC wins majority. Mamata Banerjee continues for fourth term.
phases.details: TMC won 210 seats. BJP won 72. INDIA Left-Congress won 12. Mamata Banerjee sworn in as CM for fourth consecutive term. TMC consolidated tribal and minority vote base. Source: ECI Apr 2026.

phases.description: LDF (CPM-led) wins. Pinarayi Vijayan continues for third term.
phases.details: LDF won 82 seats (CPM 59, CPI 13, others). UDF won 56 (INC 44, IUML 12). BJP won 2. Pinarayi Vijayan sworn in as CM for record third term — rare feat in Kerala. Source: ECI Apr 2026.

phases.description: BJP retains Assam. Himanta Biswa Sarma continues as CM.
phases.details: BJP won 64 seats, AGP 8 (NDA total 76). Congress-led opposition won 46. Himanta Biswa Sarma sworn in for second term. Highest turnout among 2026 state elections. Source: ECI Apr 2026.

phases.description: Most watched election — 403 seats. BJP vs SP-led INDIA bloc.
phases.details: UP elections scheduled February 2027. Current Yogi Adityanath government seeks third term. Samajwadi Party under Akhilesh Yadav leads opposition. 150 million+ voters — largest state electorate. Key test before 2029 Lok Sabha.

phases.description: 117 seats. AAP government seeks second term. Congress, BJP, Akali Dal compete.
phases.details: Punjab elections expected February 2027. Bhagwant Mann (AAP) government faces anti-incumbency test. Congress, BJP, Shiromani Akali Dal all contesting. Agricultural policy and drug menace key issues.

phases.description: 40 seats. BJP-led government vs Congress-TMC opposition.
phases.details: Goa assembly elections due in early 2027. Pramod Sawant (BJP) government seeks third term. INC and TMC competing in this small but strategically important coastal state.

phases.description: 70 seats. BJP government's third term bid vs INC.
phases.details: Uttarakhand elections due February 2027. CM Pushkar Singh Dhami (BJP) seeks third consecutive BJP win. Uniform Civil Code implementation and tourism-development issues central to campaign.

phases.description: Next General Election. 543 seats. Expected April-May 2029.
phases.details: Next General Election expected April-May 2029. Current NDA government (PM Modi, third term) serves until June 2029. Opposition INDIA bloc expected to contest as united front. This will be the most digitally-contested election in Indian history.
